description.narrative: This is an internal project. The Palme Center considers gender equality as a prerequisite for progressive development and democracy. The gendered power perspective is key for reaching sustainable results. The Palme Center commitment to working with gender equality is deeply rooted. The Palme Centers work with gender equality is based on three pillars: gender mainstreaming, targeted interventions and as a core component of organisational development. All programmes and project currently supported by the Palme Center are gender mainstreamed and include targeted interventions. Gender mainstreaming takes place both on the institutional and on the operational level and is continuously followed up on. This project aims to continue to strengthen the Palme Center and its partners capacity to work with and promote, gender equality, by ensuring that systems, resources, capacity and knowledge for working with gender equality exists and function effectively. Trainings, monitoring of theoretical developments, active participation and networking, providing methodological support, development of methodological tools, etcera, are examples of activities planned for within the project.Project OrganisationsThis is an internal project. All of the Palme Centers partner organisations will benefit, directly or indirectly, from the project.Other Donors to the OrganisationNone.Project ObjectiveThe Palme Center and its partner organisation has strengthened its systems, capacity, resources and knowledge to work with gender equality and is actively promoting gender equality in all areas of operation.
